Markets.title: Treasuries see best day in over a year as AI selloff revives haven demand
Markets.summary: US Treasury bonds experienced their largest price surge in over a year as a major selloff in artificial intelligence stocks drove demand for safe-haven assets. Consequently, investors reduced their expectations for a December Federal Reserve rate hike amid growing concerns regarding AI spending and US economic growth.

Markets.title: Neocloud short sellers rack up $6 billion as AI debt fears deepen
Markets.summary: Short sellers betting against US neocloud and data centre companies have earned about $6 billion in paper profits this month. This selloff was driven by growing investor concerns over debt-fuelled AI infrastructure spending among companies like CoreWeave, Nebius, and IREN.

Markets.title: Pershing's Ackman sees a $1 trillion Israeli company within a decade
Markets.summary: Billionaire investor Bill Ackman remains bullish on Israel's economy and financial markets. He predicts the country will produce a $1 trillion company within a decade due to its technology ecosystem and AI potential.

Markets.title: Average long-term US mortgage rate eases to 7.32% in first pullback since late August
Markets.summary: The average US 30-year fixed mortgage rate fell to 7.32% from 7.40%, marking the first decline since late August. Although this offers slight relief to homebuyers, elevated borrowing costs continue to weigh on US home sales and demand.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
Markets.summary: Indian equities fell sharply as rising crude prices, rupee weakness, and global uncertainties pressured market sentiment. The Sensex lost over 460 points, the Nifty declined 124 points, and BSE-listed companies lost Rs 3 lakh crore in market value.

Markets.title: Yes Bank unlikely to pay AT1 bond coupons despite bond holders demand, sources say
Markets.summary: Despite a Supreme Court ruling annulling a previous write-off, Yes Bank is unlikely to pay coupons on its additional tier-1 bonds this fiscal year. Although bondholders are demanding repayment, the bank maintains it holds ultimate authority over these coupon payments.

Geo-Political.title: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
Geo-Political.summary: Newborn twins Raghad and Raad are fighting for survival amidst a severe hunger crisis in Yemen. Their family was forced to flee their home on foot due to fighting between pro-government forces and the Houthis.

Geo-Political.summary: A crowd of 50 people beat an unidentified foreigner to death in South Africa. This attack follows a series of anti-migrant protests in the country this year.

Geo-Political.summary: Germany is facing intensive espionage after authorities arrested a Ukrainian man suspected of spying for Russia. This incident is one of several similar espionage cases reported in Germany this year.

Geo-Political.title: At least four dead after storm brings flooding to southern France
Geo-Political.summary: A severe storm in southern France caused flooding that resulted in at least four deaths. The fatalities include two women who drowned in a cellar in the Bouches-du-Rhône region.

Data & Insights.summary: India's oil imports from the Middle East returned to pre-war levels in September. Refiners increased spot cargo purchases as shipments through the Strait of Hormuz rose, easing Iran war-related supply constraints.

Data & Insights.summary: Between 2022 and 2026, over 100 Indian lawmakers switched political parties by exploiting loopholes in the anti-defection law. The National Democratic Alliance (NDA) emerged as the primary beneficiary of this defection wave.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC Minutes: Governor Sanjay Malhotra ties future hikes to growth-inflation outlook — here is what he said
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that future interest rate hikes will depend on the evolving growth and inflation outlook. Policymakers hold differing views on how to balance controlling inflation without unnecessarily restricting economic activity.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC minutes reveal 2 members opposed shift from neutral stance to calibrated tightening in October meeting
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India raised its repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% with unanimous support from all six monetary policy committee members. While four members backed shifting to a calibrated tightening stance, two members preferred maintaining a neutral stance during the October meeting.

Data & Insights.title: Core sector growth accelerates to 7.9% in September, fastest in new series
Data & Insights.summary: India's core sector growth accelerated to 7.9% in September, driven by double-digit increases in iron ore, electricity, coal, refinery products, and cement. However, fertilizers, natural gas, and crude oil experienced production contractions during the same month.

Data & Insights.title: India's infrastructure output grows 7.9% year-on-year in September on strong coal, steel output
Data & Insights.summary: India's infrastructure output grew by 7.9% year-on-year in September, accelerating from 3.1% growth in the same month last year. This increase was primarily driven by higher production of coal, refinery products, steel, and iron ore.

India.title: Punjab Hit As Over 3 Lakh Government Employees, Roadways Workers On Strike
India.summary: Over three lakh government employees and roadways workers in Punjab have launched a strike, causing widespread disruption to bus services across the state. The action follows a failure of negotiations between union representatives and the government.
